blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — At least 10 public utility vehicle (PUV) drivers in the Calabarzon region tested positive for illegal drugs during surprise drug tests conducted by the Land Transportation Office (LTO) at public transport terminals ahead of the Undas travel rush. In a report on Wednesday (October 28), the LTO in Region IV-A said one jeepney driver out of 100 PUV drivers subjected to random drug testing during an operation in Lipa City terminal tested positive for drug use.
